task: Deepen (flagship 7) photo-editing: a faster cubic warp so it can be the default

doc_friction.issue: The buildable note suggested 'separable passes' for the cubic warp; a warp's source point moves in x and y together, so that route does not exist. The cost was in 2-D fancy-index gathers. Rewritten in this PR.

notes: Numpy cubic warp: edge-padded planes plus shifted-view take for the 16 taps, 64-row bands on a thread pool (SHOOTFLOW_THREADS). Leica T develop SHA-256 identical before/after at 1, 2 and 4 threads for no-warp, bilinear and cubic. Cubic warp cost 15.7 s -> 8.4 s (1 thread), 3.0 s (4 threads). Default kernel switched to cubic in DevelopSettings and the CLI. Local checks: photo-editing unittest suite via pytest 879 passed, 5 skipped; ruff clean; mypy shows one pre-existing error in raw_develop_np.py:295 (untouched file, numpy-stub dependent).
